Echoes of Central Park DLC - Tom Clancy’s The Division 2

name: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
storyline: The story explores the idea of a society so gripped by paranoia of an unknown sinister threat. Fear feeds on itself until rumors become truth. In a first for The Division 2, Echoes of Central Park takes place in the form of a flashback as a narrator guides you through her version of events.
summary: A narrative-driven DLC expansion where you explore a decayed Central Park and Upper West Side gripped by paranoia over a mysterious virus variant. Guided by a narrator recounting events as a flashback, you uncover what happened in the park while battling a new apex threat and familiar foes. You're joined by three companions with distinct fighting styles and backgrounds, each offering unique tactical support and reactions to situations. The endgame shifts you from hunted survivor to hunter, letting you dictate engagements and pursue enemies on your own terms, with your performance affecting future challenges and exclusive rewards. New skill variants and an exotic weapon round out the expansion.
